overview: The committee approved consultant amendments and invoices while reviewing a recent presentation to the MSBA Facilities Assessment Subcommittee (FAS). Discussion focused on the inclusion of a Teen Health Center and a detailed review of specific categories within the project’s space summary.

items.title: Approval of Invoices
items.summary: Approved June 2026 invoices totaling $155,375 for Left Field and SMMA.

items.title: SMMA Amendment for Specialty Consultants
items.summary: Approved an amendment for SMMA to cover specialty consultants for geothermal, solar, and pool design, excluding the $9,000 cost for a new pool basin. Committee members discussed the necessity of geothermal expertise and the scheduling of pool testing to avoid disrupting summer programs.

items.title: FAS Meeting Update
items.summary: Received a summary of the July 15 presentation to the MSBA Facilities Assessment Subcommittee (FAS), which covered the educational plan, site topography, and building organization. The committee noted positive feedback from the MSBA regarding the project's integration of special education and vocational programs.

items.title: Teen Health Center Update
items.summary: Reviewed the School Committee’s vote to support including a Teen Health Center in the building project to provide medical and mental health services to students. Committee members debated the accessibility of the high school site for the broader community compared to its benefits for students.

items.title: Space Summary Review: Medical, Guidance, and Custodial
items.summary: Began a section-by-section review of the project’s space summary, focusing on medical suites, counseling offices, and maintenance areas. Architects explained variances from MSBA guidelines intended to accommodate existing staffing models and specialized programs like the STEPS hospital re-entry program.

items.title: Schematic Design Overview
items.summary: Reviewed the timeline for the Schematic Design phase, which includes budget finalization and a targeted city-wide vote in June 2027.

items.title: Project Website Motion
items.summary: Approved a motion to update the project website to make the current revision of the Educational Plan explicitly available to the public.
